topic: A bad review that the owner never answered. It gets older, strangers read it and then read the silence under it. Fix: a short, calm reply, written for the next person who reads it.

says.text: Ouch! And nobody ever wrote back?
People looking you up can see that!

actions.text:
You're right. We're sorry.
We fixed it.

caption:
There's a review on your profile that you never answered. Maybe it was unfair. Maybe it was just a bad day. Either way, it's still there.

People who look you up read it. Then they look underneath to see what you said. If there's nothing, the review gets the last word.

So answer it, even if it's old. Two or three calm sentences: say sorry for what went wrong and say what you changed. Don't argue and don't explain for a whole paragraph.

You're not writing to the person who left it. You're writing to the next person who reads it.

This works with or without a website. A Google profile is enough.

When did you last reply to a review?
